title: He missed out on payouts, so he built his own prop firm
caption: Tradever's CEO Layth on why he started a prop firm: he was the trader who didn't get paid. #tradever #propfirm #daytrading #futurestrading #ad @tradeverfunding @laythbanks

slides.text: He missed out on *hundreds of thousands* in payouts.
slides.sub: So he built his own prop firm.

slides.text: I've been a victim of trading on a prop firm and not getting payouts.
If you don't pay people out, you're not staying in business for a long time.
The reason why I launched my own prop firm is to mitigate people from not getting a payout.
